commits.message:
Add comprehensive OAuth 2.1 and OIDC documentation

- Add Chinese documentation (OAuth2.1-OIDC.md) with complete usage guide
- Add English documentation (OAuth2.1-OIDC-EN.md) with complete usage guide
- Update README.md to highlight new OAuth 2.1 and OIDC features
- Include PKCE implementation examples in JavaScript
- Document all OIDC endpoints and scopes
- Add security recommendations

Co-authored-by: Hansin1997 <21296198+Hansin1997@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
commits.message:
Integrate PKCE validation into authorization and token flow

- Update AuthorizationController to capture and store PKCE parameters (code_challenge, code_challenge_method)
- Create PkceAuthorizationCodeTokenGranter to validate code_verifier
- Update AuthorizationServerConfiguration to use PKCE-aware token granter
- Add OIDC issuer configuration in application.yaml
- Complete OAuth 2.1 PKCE support for authorization code flow

Co-authored-by: Hansin1997 <21296198+Hansin1997@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
commits.message:
Add OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.1 PKCE support

- Add UserInfo endpoint (GET/POST /userinfo) for OIDC
- Add OIDC Discovery endpoint (/.well-known/openid-configuration)
- Add OpenID Connect claims to JWT tokens (sub, name, email, phone, etc.)
- Add PKCE service for OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow
- Create PKCE-aware authorization code service
- Add support for profile, email, and phone scopes
- Add support for code_challenge and code_verifier parameters

Co-authored-by: Hansin1997 <21296198+Hansin1997@users.noreply.github.com>
